goal: Prevent malformed JSON-RPC batch elements from inheriting prior IDs or dropping error responses
Ensures RPC clients receive compliant, distinct response IDs when batches contain invalid items
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Reasonable follow-up to conform to JSON-RPC 2.0 spec and avoid confusing consumers (pinheadmz)
Verified the patch fixes the bug by testing failure without it (janb84)
Suggested using a fresh request per batch element rather than resetting fields, now adopted (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes a JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance bug where non-object items inherit the prior element's ID
It prevents dropped error responses after notifications, but triggers only on malformed batch items
